xs.$description: Padding inside the smallest elements: badges, tags, and chips.

sm.$description: Padding inside small controls and compact list items.

md.$description: Padding inside controls and list items.

lg.$description: Default padding inside components such as alerts, menus, and popovers.

xl.$description: Padding inside cards, modals, and other large containers.

xs.$description: Gap between tightly related items, such as an icon and its text in small controls.

sm.$description: Default gap between an icon and its label, and between items in a compact group.

md.$description: Gap between items in a list or a row of controls.

lg.$description: Gap between related elements in a component.

xl.$description: Gap between groups within a component, or between sections inside a card or modal.

sm.$description: Gap between sections of a page.

md.$description: Gap between major page regions, such as the header and the content.

lg.$description: The largest page gap, around page sections and hero areas.
